title: Cactus Hybrid: We taught Gemma 4 to know when it's wrong
claim: Show HN: Cactus Hybrid: We taught Gemma 4 to know when it's wrong
why_good: The ability to teach AI systems to recognize their own errors can lead to more reliable and trustworthy AI applications across various industries.
value: Businesses could pay for a subscription service that enhances their AI tools with error recognition capabilities, improving performance and reducing costs associated with AI failures.
risk: The technology could be seen as a feature rather than a standalone product, making it vulnerable to being integrated into existing AI platforms by larger companies.
